source_metadata_basis: Commons current imageinfo/extmetadata, exact original SHA-1 comparison before normalization, current official licensing pages; no model output used for provenance.
model_input_policy: Only image pixels and any deliberately specified user-like description. Never filenames, hashes, source URLs, catalogue IDs or evaluator work labels. Real uploads use the same preprocessing and server path as these controls.
limitations: Only three open-movie works, all associated with Blender Foundation; not representative of commercial cinema, TV, Russian works, anime or an entire catalogue.
A recognized full still does not prove arbitrary-shot recognition; ambiguous and low-quality controls must be reported separately.
Quality difference is controlled only for control-01/control-05; orientation difference for control-02/control-06. Different works/frames are not clean quality ablations.
Physical iPhone/Safari/PWA test not performed. These files are inputs, not inference results.

license_checks.role: Secondary release-year cross-check; creation date, not date-based inference of identity.
